notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

news_signal.method: Freshness × source quality × relevance × novelty, with bounded headline-direction lexicon. News is a context modifier, not a standalone trade signal.

company_context.news_note: Recent headlines are scored as a bounded catalyst/context modifier using freshness, source quality, relevance and novelty. News alone cannot create a BUY candidate.

plain_language: The directional model has not shown strong out-of-sample discrimination, so its probability should receive limited weight.
Comparable historical signals are not clearly separated from the ticker's normal base rate, so the current signal adds limited directional evidence.
The nearest-expiration at-the-money straddle is pricing a move of roughly 0.6% of the stock price, before transaction costs.

options.status: Historical distribution + fallback option snapshot active

chain.quote_note: Quotes are selected per contract by provider quality, feed authority, freshness, and cross-provider agreement. A newer indicative/delayed quote cannot override a trustworthy consolidated real-time quote.

opportunity_radar.method_note: Today's contract economics replayed across historical underlying moves. Profit-frequency uncertainty and qualification use an overlap-adjusted effective sample count because multi-day forward returns overlap. Results are hypothetical, exclude changing historical IV/Greeks and are not a profitability guarantee.

notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

news_signal.method: Freshness × source quality × relevance × novelty, with bounded headline-direction lexicon. News is a context modifier, not a standalone trade signal.

company_context.news_note: Recent headlines are scored as a bounded catalyst/context modifier using freshness, source quality, relevance and novelty. News alone cannot create a BUY candidate.

opportunity_radar.method_note: Today's contract economics replayed across historical underlying moves. Profit-frequency uncertainty and qualification use an overlap-adjusted effective sample count because multi-day forward returns overlap. Results are hypothetical, exclude changing historical IV/Greeks and are not a profitability guarantee.

notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

news_signal.method: Freshness × source quality × relevance × novelty, with bounded headline-direction lexicon. News is a context modifier, not a standalone trade signal.

company_context.news_note: Recent headlines are scored as a bounded catalyst/context modifier using freshness, source quality, relevance and novelty. News alone cannot create a BUY candidate.

plain_language: The directional model has not shown strong out-of-sample discrimination, so its probability should receive limited weight.
Comparable historical signals are not clearly separated from the ticker's normal base rate, so the current signal adds limited directional evidence.

The nearest-expiration at-the-money straddle is pricing a move of roughly 1.1% of the stock price, before transaction costs.

opportunity_radar.method_note: Today's contract economics replayed across historical underlying moves. Profit-frequency uncertainty and qualification use an overlap-adjusted effective sample count because multi-day forward returns overlap. Results are hypothetical, exclude changing historical IV/Greeks and are not a profitability guarantee.

notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

news_signal.method: Freshness × source quality × relevance × novelty, with bounded headline-direction lexicon. News is a context modifier, not a standalone trade signal.

company_context.news_note: Recent headlines are scored as a bounded catalyst/context modifier using freshness, source quality, relevance and novelty. News alone cannot create a BUY candidate.

plain_language: The directional model has not shown strong out-of-sample discrimination, so its probability should receive limited weight.
Comparable historical signals are not clearly separated from the ticker's normal base rate, so the current signal adds limited directional evidence.
Over the last 20 trading days, VXUS has underperformed SPY by about 4.3 percentage points.
The nearest-expiration at-the-money straddle is pricing a move of roughly 0.9% of the stock price, before transaction costs.

chain.quote_note: Quotes are selected per contract by provider quality, feed authority, freshness, and cross-provider agreement. A newer indicative/delayed quote cannot override a trustworthy consolidated real-time quote.

guidance.note: No contract currently clears the full quality, execution and historical-evidence gates.

opportunity_radar.method_note: Today's contract economics replayed across historical underlying moves. Profit-frequency uncertainty and qualification use an overlap-adjusted effective sample count because multi-day forward returns overlap. Results are hypothetical, exclude changing historical IV/Greeks and are not a profitability guarantee.

notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

news_signal.method: Freshness × source quality × relevance × novelty, with bounded headline-direction lexicon. News is a context modifier, not a standalone trade signal.

company_context.news_note: Recent headlines are scored as a bounded catalyst/context modifier using freshness, source quality, relevance and novelty. News alone cannot create a BUY candidate.

plain_language: The directional model has not shown strong out-of-sample discrimination, so its probability should receive limited weight.
Comparable historical signals are not clearly separated from the ticker's normal base rate, so the current signal adds limited directional evidence.
Earnings are about 14 days away and should be considered when choosing an expiration.
Over the last 20 trading days, INTC has underperformed SPY by about 5.2 percentage points.
Recent earnings dates in the available history produced an average absolute next-session move of about 2.3%.
The nearest-expiration at-the-money straddle is pricing a move of roughly 4.4% of the stock price, before transaction costs.

options.status: Historical distribution + fallback option snapshot active

chain.quote_note: Quotes are selected per contract by provider quality, feed authority, freshness, and cross-provider agreement. A newer indicative/delayed quote cannot override a trustworthy consolidated real-time quote.

guidance.note: No contract currently clears the full quality, execution and historical-evidence gates.

opportunity_radar.method_note: Today's contract economics replayed across historical underlying moves. Profit-frequency uncertainty and qualification use an overlap-adjusted effective sample count because multi-day forward returns overlap. Results are hypothetical, exclude changing historical IV/Greeks and are not a profitability guarantee.

notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

news_signal.method: Freshness × source quality × relevance × novelty, with bounded headline-direction lexicon. News is a context modifier, not a standalone trade signal.

company_context.news_note: Recent headlines are scored as a bounded catalyst/context modifier using freshness, source quality, relevance and novelty. News alone cannot create a BUY candidate.

plain_language: The directional model has shown modest historical discrimination, but the signal should be confirmed by other evidence.
Comparable historical signals are not clearly separated from the ticker's normal base rate, so the current signal adds limited directional evidence.
Over the last 20 trading days, MU has underperformed SPY by about 3.6 percentage points.
Recent earnings dates in the available history produced an average absolute next-session move of about 1.6%.
The nearest-expiration at-the-money straddle is pricing a move of roughly 4.1% of the stock price, before transaction costs.

options.status: Historical distribution + fallback option snapshot active

chain.quote_note: Quotes are selected per contract by provider quality, feed authority, freshness, and cross-provider agreement. A newer indicative/delayed quote cannot override a trustworthy consolidated real-time quote.

guidance.note: No contract currently clears the full quality, execution and historical-evidence gates.

opportunity_radar.method_note: Today's contract economics replayed across historical underlying moves. Profit-frequency uncertainty and qualification use an overlap-adjusted effective sample count because multi-day forward returns overlap. Results are hypothetical, exclude changing historical IV/Greeks and are not a profitability guarantee.

notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

news_signal.method: Freshness × source quality × relevance × novelty, with bounded headline-direction lexicon. News is a context modifier, not a standalone trade signal.

company_context.news_note: Recent headlines are scored as a bounded catalyst/context modifier using freshness, source quality, relevance and novelty. News alone cannot create a BUY candidate.

plain_language: The directional model has not shown strong out-of-sample discrimination, so its probability should receive limited weight.
Comparable historical signals are not clearly separated from the ticker's normal base rate, so the current signal adds limited directional evidence.
Earnings are about 6 days away, creating substantial event and implied-volatility risk.
Over the last 20 trading days, META has outperformed SPY by about 10.9 percentage points.
Recent earnings dates in the available history produced an average absolute next-session move of about 2.0%.
The nearest-expiration at-the-money straddle is pricing a move of roughly 3.4% of the stock price, before transaction costs.

options.status: Historical distribution + fallback option snapshot active

chain.quote_note: Quotes are selected per contract by provider quality, feed authority, freshness, and cross-provider agreement. A newer indicative/delayed quote cannot override a trustworthy consolidated real-time quote.

opportunity_radar.method_note: Today's contract economics replayed across historical underlying moves. Profit-frequency uncertainty and qualification use an overlap-adjusted effective sample count because multi-day forward returns overlap. Results are hypothetical, exclude changing historical IV/Greeks and are not a profitability guarantee.

news_signal.method: Freshness × source quality × relevance × novelty, with bounded headline-direction lexicon. News is a context modifier, not a standalone trade signal.

company_context.news_note: Recent headlines are scored as a bounded catalyst/context modifier using freshness, source quality, relevance and novelty. News alone cannot create a BUY candidate.

chain.quote_note: Quotes are selected per contract by provider quality, feed authority, freshness, and cross-provider agreement. A newer indicative/delayed quote cannot override a trustworthy consolidated real-time quote.

guidance.note: No contract currently clears the full quality, execution and historical-evidence gates.

opportunity_radar.method_note: Today's contract economics replayed across historical underlying moves. Profit-frequency uncertainty and qualification use an overlap-adjusted effective sample count because multi-day forward returns overlap. Results are hypothetical, exclude changing historical IV/Greeks and are not a profitability guarantee.

notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

news_signal.method: Freshness × source quality × relevance × novelty, with bounded headline-direction lexicon. News is a context modifier, not a standalone trade signal.

company_context.news_note: Recent headlines are scored as a bounded catalyst/context modifier using freshness, source quality, relevance and novelty. News alone cannot create a BUY candidate.

plain_language: The directional model has not shown strong out-of-sample discrimination, so its probability should receive limited weight.
Comparable historical signals are not clearly separated from the ticker's normal base rate, so the current signal adds limited directional evidence.
Over the last 20 trading days, ORCL has underperformed SPY by about 10.8 percentage points.
Recent earnings dates in the available history produced an average absolute next-session move of about 1.7%.
The nearest-expiration at-the-money straddle is pricing a move of roughly 4.2% of the stock price, before transaction costs.

chain.quote_note: Quotes are selected per contract by provider quality, feed authority, freshness, and cross-provider agreement. A newer indicative/delayed quote cannot override a trustworthy consolidated real-time quote.

reasons: Historical payoff replay had positive mean P/L
Quoted spread is relatively tight
risks: Directional ML model has not demonstrated strong out-of-sample discrimination

guidance.note: No contract currently clears the full quality, execution and historical-evidence gates.

opportunity_radar.method_note: Today's contract economics replayed across historical underlying moves. Profit-frequency uncertainty and qualification use an overlap-adjusted effective sample count because multi-day forward returns overlap. Results are hypothetical, exclude changing historical IV/Greeks and are not a profitability guarantee.

notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

news_signal.method: Freshness × source quality × relevance × novelty, with bounded headline-direction lexicon. News is a context modifier, not a standalone trade signal.

company_context.news_note: Recent headlines are scored as a bounded catalyst/context modifier using freshness, source quality, relevance and novelty. News alone cannot create a BUY candidate.

plain_language: The directional model has not shown strong out-of-sample discrimination, so its probability should receive limited weight.
Comparable historical signals are not clearly separated from the ticker's normal base rate, so the current signal adds limited directional evidence.
Over the last 20 trading days, NVDA has outperformed SPY by about 1.1 percentage points.
Recent earnings dates in the available history produced an average absolute next-session move of about 1.7%.
The nearest-expiration at-the-money straddle is pricing a move of roughly 2.7% of the stock price, before transaction costs.

options.status: Historical distribution + fallback option snapshot active

chain.quote_note: Quotes are selected per contract by provider quality, feed authority, freshness, and cross-provider agreement. A newer indicative/delayed quote cannot override a trustworthy consolidated real-time quote.

guidance.note: No contract currently clears the full quality, execution and historical-evidence gates.

opportunity_radar.method_note: Today's contract economics replayed across historical underlying moves. Profit-frequency uncertainty and qualification use an overlap-adjusted effective sample count because multi-day forward returns overlap. Results are hypothetical, exclude changing historical IV/Greeks and are not a profitability guarantee.

notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

news_signal.method: Freshness × source quality × relevance × novelty, with bounded headline-direction lexicon. News is a context modifier, not a standalone trade signal.

company_context.news_note: Recent headlines are scored as a bounded catalyst/context modifier using freshness, source quality, relevance and novelty. News alone cannot create a BUY candidate.

plain_language: The directional model has not shown strong out-of-sample discrimination, so its probability should receive limited weight.
Comparable historical signals are not clearly separated from the ticker's normal base rate, so the current signal adds limited directional evidence.
Earnings are about 19 days away and should be considered when choosing an expiration.
Over the last 20 trading days, SHOP has outperformed SPY by about 33.0 percentage points.
Recent earnings dates in the available history produced an average absolute next-session move of about 12.1%.
The nearest-expiration at-the-money straddle is pricing a move of roughly 4.2% of the stock price, before transaction costs.

options.status: Historical distribution + fallback option snapshot active

chain.quote_note: Quotes are selected per contract by provider quality, feed authority, freshness, and cross-provider agreement. A newer indicative/delayed quote cannot override a trustworthy consolidated real-time quote.
